title: Autumn Trench Magic 🍂✨
content:
This collection is inspired by the essence of autumn: warm tones, layered silhouettes, and timeless trench coats reimagined with bold details. From oversized plaid shirts paired with long trench layers, to striking contrasts of red-black tartan, and soft neutral looks with voluminous sleeves — each design celebrates the textures and spirit of the season.  
It’s not just fashion, it’s the magic of fall translated into digital couture.

title: Empress of Autumn ✨🍂
content:
The arrival of autumn brings a symphony of colors — and this design embodies it all. A flowing silhouette in deep crimson, adorned with cascading leaves, captures the essence of change, warmth, and timeless elegance. Every fold of fabric becomes a branch of poetry, every golden accent a whisper of falling foliage. 🍂✨ This gown is not just fashion, but a celebration of the season’s magic.

title: Colourway issue
content:
Hi Clo team,

I kind of kept encountering glitches these days. I wonder, is it bc the avatar i use? The client asked us to use a new avatar which they made it on their own. I never had any problems like these before with the old one. They seemingly began to happen since the updated patch and the changed avatar. idk, just a thought.  
  
Anyway, aside from the previous colour map issue, I found that some of the thread colour of buttonholes is at sync regardless of colourways. I noticed and i added a new one and deleted the old one. Making sure there are no yellow highlights on the thread colour of buttonholes. Which suggests that they arent at sync. However, after i saved the file then re-opened it, it's still the same as if i've never revised anything. I rly have no idea why this could be happening. Pls help me out if there's anything I missed out on.![c102f85495e24841a33d0cfc32ed2765](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/7fd75725e0454f5e8377a3dee77891e1/images/c102f85495e24841a33d0cfc32ed2765scrnshot%203.jpg)![ef38220b1f124265a8873c762359920a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202509/7fd75725e0454f5e8377a3dee77891e1/images/ef38220b1f124265a8873c762359920ascrnshot%204.jpg)
content_description: This web page serves as a support forum for the Clo team to address technical glitches related to avatar updates and buttonhole color synchronization issues.
